title: Efficiency of mutation reduction for Brauer trees
summary: Brauer tree algebras are important and fundamental blocks in the modular representation theory of groups. Aihara develped an algorithm, which we call a mutation reduction, for getting from a Brauer tree algebra to the simpler Brauer star algebra using a sequence of mutations centered on edges. Schaps and Zvi, using the Schaps-Zakay theory of pointing the tree, showed that different algorithms for the sequence of mutations give permutations of the edges.
